Eva and Sam are preparing a report about the library desk. The experience taught Sam more than any book could. The bus card machine has become an important part of daily life. The staircase spirals to the roof.
Sam thanked Eva for the honest advice. Sam's dream job is to be a nurse. On Sunday evenings, Sam reviews the notes from class. What's more, readings move to the library annex.

Sam believes that trying new things keeps life fresh. There is still a long way to go, but the direction is right. People around Sam often share different ideas about the library desk. They bought a small property by the lake.
What matters most is not speed, but keeping on. At first, Sam found it difficult to keep the habit. Eva always says that small steps matter more than big plans. Organic vegetables cost a little more.
Sam wrote down every idea in a small notebook. There are always more possibilities than we expect. Eva advised Sam to try dancing as a new hobby.
